visual.start: High-contrast editorial layout establishing DIRECT WIRING VS RELAY.
visual.action: Comparative split screen illustrating the fatal flaw of direct wiring. The left panel shows thin wires glowing red-hot, throwing sparks, and burning with a big red ✕ hazard badge when 60 Amps flows through. The right panel shows the thick copper starter relay safely handling the heavy electrical flood.
visual.camera: Stable front-facing vertical framing with safety margins.
visual.end: Visual transformation completes, seamlessly resolving into next scene.

scenes.title: STARTER RELAY (SOLENOID)
scenes.purpose: Explain the mechanism and takeaway of STARTER RELAY (SOLENOID).
scenes.narration: इसलिए बटन सिर्फ डेढ़ ऐम्पियर करंट एक इलेक्ट्रो-मैग्नेट को भेजता है। ये चुंबक अंदर एक मोटी तांबे की प्लेट खींचकर बैटरी का भारी करंट सीधे मोटर तक पहुँचा देता है!

visual.start: High-contrast editorial layout establishing STARTER RELAY (SOLENOID).
visual.action: Technical diagram of the dual-circuit starter solenoid. A thin cyan line carries a safe 1.5-Amp current from the handlebar button to the internal copper coil. The energized electromagnet snaps a heavy iron plunger down, bridging two massive brass studs with a thick copper plate to deliver 60 Amps directly from the 12V battery to the motor.
visual.camera: Stable front-facing vertical framing with safety margins.
visual.end: Visual transformation completes, seamlessly resolving into next scene.

scenes.title: ONE-WAY SPRAG CLUTCH
scenes.purpose: Explain the mechanism and takeaway of ONE-WAY SPRAG CLUTCH.
scenes.narration: जैसे ही स्पार्क प्लग जलता है, इंजन चौदह सौ आर-पी-एम पर भागने लगता है। अगर मोटर जुड़ी रही, तो गियर उसे सत्रह हज़ार आर-पी-एम पर घुमाकर ब्लास्ट कर देंगे! लेकिन वन-वे स्प्रैग क्लच इंजन शुरू होते ही मोटर को तुरंत फ्री कर देता है!

visual.start: Dark 3D spatial coordinate grid with directional volumetric lighting.
objects: Pbr Metal Materials. The Inner Race
visual.action: Real 3D CAD model of the one-way sprag clutch mechanism with PBR metal materials. The inner race and sprag rollers rotate into focus, illustrating how the asymmetrical sprags instantly disengage and slip into freewheel mode within 5 milliseconds as the engine roars to 1,400 RPM, shielding the starter motor from catastrophic 17,000 RPM overspeed destruction.
visual.camera: Motivated tracking camera orbiting the focal 3D model.
visual.end: Model locks into informative angle for seamless scene cut.
